string-array.name: guide_generic_steps
string-array.item: Tap \"Build Number\" 7 times in a row
When you see \"You are now a developer\", go back to Settings

string-array.name: guide_samsung_steps
string-array.item: Tap \"Build Number\" 7 times in a row

string-array.name: guide_xiaomi_steps
string-array.item: Go back to the main Settings, open \"Additional Settings\" > \"Developer Options\"

string-array.name: guide_huawei_steps
string-array.item: Tap \"Build Number\" 7 times in a row
Open \"Developer Options\" under \"System and Updates\" (or the Settings home screen)

string-array.name: guide_coloros_steps
string-array.item: Tap \"Build Number\" 7 times in a row
Go back to the main Settings, open \"Additional Settings\" > \"Developer Options\"

string-array.name: guide_vivo_steps
string-array.item: Go to \"About Phone\" (may be under \"Other Settings\")
Tap \"Software Version\" 7 times in a row

string-array.name: guide_pixel_steps
string-array.item: Tap \"Build Number\" 7 times in a row
Go back to the main Settings, open \"System\" > \"Developer Options\"

string-array.name: wizard_can_do_lines
string-array.item: Read every hardware key, with no delay
Run the settings changes and commands you write
Keep working while the app is closed

string-array.name: wizard_never_does_lines
string-array.item: Take input away from other apps
Send anything you didn’t put in a shortcut

string-array.name: wizard_pairing_steps
string-array.item: Tap the button below to open Wireless Debugging settings.
From the menu, choose ‘Pair device with pairing code’.
We’ll read the pairing code and connect automatically.
